subject.title: fix(skills): forward owner handle to bulk security-verdict fetch for ambiguous slugs

question: Should ambiguous owner-qualified skills be resolved by a coordinated ClawHub bulk-endpoint contract change, or should OpenClaw fall back per item to the already-supported owner-qualified verify endpoint?
rationale: The current external API evidence rules out field forwarding alone, while a fallback changes the authoritative verdict-routing behavior and failure semantics that OpenClaw exposes to users.

options.title: Coordinate an owner-aware bulk contract
options.body: Keep OpenClaw bulk-only and merge a matching OpenClaw change after ClawHub proves that its bulk endpoint resolves `{ slug, version, ownerHandle }`.

options.title: Add a narrow supported fallback
options.body: On an owner-qualified bulk ambiguity/not-found result, call the supported owner-qualified verify endpoint for that item and retain explicit tests for ordinary bulk behavior.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow supported fallback
recommendation.body: On an owner-qualified bulk ambiguity/not-found result, call the supported owner-qualified verify endpoint for that item and retain explicit tests for ordinary bulk behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The outstanding choice is at the ClawHub bulk-verdict service boundary; no attributable owner was available in the supplied context.
